name: Xani Green
source: After the loss of her mother at a young age, the protagonist lost her once optimistic outlook and began having trouble seeing good in the world. Now cynical, headstrong, and critical, she finds her life turned upside down once again after discovering a long-kept secret. Thrown into a world of secrets and lies, what future awaits her at your hands?
